scene.speaker: diego
scene.bubble: Kili delivered a photo album… to the wrong house! It belongs to a monster family. Let's describe them to find their home!

activities.title: Who is who? Choose the correct monster.

data.instructions: Read the description and choose the right monster.

items.sentence: He is very tall and thin, with curly purple hair.
She is old and short, with a kind smile and grey curly hair.
He is the youngest, with three little teeth.
She has got long straight blue hair and big glasses.
He has got a very long white beard — he's the oldest.

activities.title: Listen. Diego describes the family photo. Write a word or number in each gap.

data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (describiendo) y Kili (buscando desde el aire).
data.script: Diego: Okay Kili, listen! In the photo there are six monsters. … Diego: The father is very fat and green, with curly orange hair. … Diego: The mother is tall and thin, and she has got four friendly eyes. … Diego: The grandpa has got a white beard that is two metres long! … Diego: The twins are young — they have got the same purple noses. … Diego: And the baby is asleep in a shoe. A big red shoe! … Diego: Their house must be the one with the enormous door. Fly, Kili, fly!

data.text: Draw a monster secretly. Describe it to your partner (has got…, is…) while they draw it. Compare drawings — the funniest difference wins!

activities.title: Two pictures, many differences!
activities.instructions: Look at picture A and picture B. Find the 12 differences and tell your partner about them.

activities.title: Listen and write the names.
activities.instructions: Look at the picture. Listen and write the name under each person. Careful: there are three names you do not need.

kpi.puede: Understand dialogues and short stories (Flyers parts 1–5); infer mood from intonation.

data.script: Look at the picture. Listen and write the names. There is one example. … Diego: Who is that in the front of the school? The boy in the red shirt with a microphone. … Maya: That is Diego. Diego is asking questions with his microphone. … Diego: And who is the big black bird with a white collar? … Maya: That is Kili. Look, Kili is carrying a letter. … Diego: And who is the big green monster with three eyes and a lot of hair? … Maya: That is Grum. Look, Grum is smiling. … Diego: And who is the purple monster with one eye and two very long arms? … Maya: That is Zog. Look, Zog is waving one long arm. … Diego: And who is the little round orange monster with four eyes? … Maya: That is Zip. Look, Zip is jumping.
data.voice_note: Voces: Diego (nino, reportero) pregunta y Maya (nina, cientifica) responde.

activities.instructions: Look at the pictures. Write the story in 20-25 words. Use the words under each picture to help you.
